en.summary: After the BNP's landslide in the February 2026 election, Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's government is using a record Tk 9.38 trillion budget to tame prices, widen social protection such as the Family Card, and improve the investment climate. Invest Bangladesh, which merges BIDA, BEZA and PPPA, now serves as a one-stop investment agency.
